20261118-chemistry-g01.s.s1.prompt: [E1 Nnyocha Kemistri] Ajụjụ olu gas gbasara Nchọpụta ihe. Na $25^\circ\text{C}$ na $1\text{ atm}$, olu molar nke gas bụ $24.5\text{ L/mol}$. N'otu ọnọdụ ahụ, gịnị bụ olu na $\text{L}$ nke $0.2\text{ mol}$ nke gas a?
20261118-chemistry-g01.s.s1.explain:

Nzọụkwụ 2: $V = 0.2\text{ mol} \times 24.5\text{ L/mol}$.
Nzọụkwụ 3: Ngụkọta na-enye $V = 4.90\text{ L}$.

20261122-chemistry-g02-1.material: [E2 Nnyocha Kemistri] Ajụjụ olu gas gbasara Ntụ na ngwakọta. Na $25^\circ\text{C}$ na $1\text{ atm}$, olu molar nke gas bụ $24.5\text{ L/mol}$. N'otu ọnọdụ ahụ, gịnị bụ olu na $\text{L}$ nke $0.2\text{ mol}$ nke gas a?
20261122-chemistry-g02-1.s.s1.prompt: [E2 Nnyocha Kemistri] Ajụjụ olu gas gbasara Ntụ na ngwakọta. Na $25^\circ\text{C}$ na $1\text{ atm}$, olu molar nke gas bụ $24.5\text{ L/mol}$. N'otu ọnọdụ ahụ, gịnị bụ olu na $\text{L}$ nke $0.2\text{ mol}$ nke gas a?
20261122-chemistry-g02-1.s.s1.explain:
Nzọụkwụ 1: Dị ka iwu Avogadro si dị, olu $V = n \times V_m$.
Nzọụkwụ 2: $V = 0.2\text{ mol} \times 24.5\text{ L/mol}$.
Nzọụkwụ 3: Ngụkọta na-enye $V = 4.90\text{ L}$.
